test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘APRON’ is written as ‘CNTMP’ and ‘EARTH’ is written as ‘GYTRJ’. How will ‘HEAVY’ be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• **Alphabets placed at even places are decreased to 2 positional values.**
 
• **Alphabets placed at odd places are increased to 2 positional values.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a13d7735186cc56a4595c7273f02d2a3f9424419ec69de5486da8d77412ad330.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb78ae79b67f78bdf75265ad0ebc0b6e15bfdfef18da862b7f1f217cf5f17b26.png] 

Similarly, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31481e23c9e66de83fa465c162d8d46b78830675a930b976e44899321838e5b6.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is JCCTA.**
